title: First night at the Savoy Ballroom, thrown off the floor
summary: Holmes and Carney arrive in March 1927, are awed by the Savoy, and bouncers push them off the dance floor when they try to greet Hodges.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That was what? In '28 you were 17?

'27. 1927. I'll never forget it. I think it was March the twelfth, but I wouldn't bet on it because they changed the dates around. I know at the Savoy Ballroom, the next night after we got here, they had an anniversary dance at the Savoy Ballroom the next night. The Savoy had only been open one year when we got here -- and I forgot what date they opened.

But anyway, we got here the first night, and we go, naturally, to the Savoy to see Johnny and to see what the Savoy looked like. We'd heard about it, but I had never been there, and it had only been open a year. And actually, when we walked in, it was the most gorgeous thing I'd ever seen in my life. The Savoy Ballroom, I never.. I'd seen nice-looking ballrooms, but nothing like that. So we walked right in, right across the floor, right in front of the bandstand, talked to Johnny -- "Hey, yeah, Johnny, blah-blah-blah." And here come the bouncers and run us right off
the floor, run us off to the side. I said, "Well, look, that's my friend, that's my friend, I know him." He said, "Well, you wait til he gets off the bandstand. Talk to him over there."
